note: Continuous tenant-wide ingest (host ingest mode): every source through its own capture CLI. Mail: every mailbox of the directory minus the exclusion list (integrations/mail_capture_scope.json all_mailboxes; PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS withholds the excluded people before any read). SharePoint: every document library of every site of the tenant and its OneDrive host (integrations/sharepoint_estate_scope.json discover, nothing excluded; each cycle resumes every root within budget_seconds, a cut root stays a named gap; business rule everything, 2026-10-27); SharePoint lists: the committed list scope. BC: every entity set of CAPTURE_ENTITY_SETS for Production / My Company (bc_company_books.json); with purchaseOrders the capture also reads ODataV4 Page 50 PurchaseOrder (No, Your_Reference, Buy_from_Vendor_No; Prefer odata.maxpagesize=1000) as purchaseOrderReferences, the field that links BC orders to Portal POs. Portal: every relation the reporting API's live catalog serves (no hand list: with no relations named, the mirror's sync reads the catalog each cycle, so a relation the service starts serving is read without a config change; ordered stalest first, large fills last). Teams: the product scope; MC: scope live, every task, bucket and project the operator may see (the full task listing every cycle, then mc_get_task for every task in task-id order until budget_seconds pauses it; the cursor resumes the next cycle), plus one ranked knowledge query. Mail, SharePoint, BC and MC children run as the host capture principal (svc:workbench-host) under ingest_all.capture-audience.json (mail:*, sharepoint:*, bc:production:*, mc:live:*); an MC store stamped for another tenant (the live check's) is moved aside and captured again for the host tenant: a mail or SharePoint child run as its CLI default principal sees no mailbox and no library (not_visible), and a BC child bound to its own service audience is refused by the host's BC store (binding_mismatch). Configuration, never a grant: the Exchange application access policy and the people-exclusion guard still bound what is read. Budgets sum to about 5800 s a cycle. Paths are relative to this file.
